name: scrape_products
description: Renders product pages /products/N.html with headless Chromium, reads #name, #price, #buy (enabled=inStock), writes products.json in the project dir and returns a summary.
whenToUse: To scrape or re-check prices/stock of the shop product pages.

output.description: Output file name in project dir (default products.json)

provenance.reason: 15 JS-rendered pages, to be re-checked later
